popup.title: APEX MD MINI
popup.text: Fast, reliable, and modular WhatsApp automation bot. Link your WhatsApp number effortlessly in a minute.

features.title: Linked in about a minute
features.text: Enter your number, get a code, type it into WhatsApp. The bot connects right away.

features.title: Two ways to pair
features.text: Use an 8-character pairing code or scan a QR code. Pick whichever is easier on your phone.

features.title: Group tools
features.text: Welcome messages, anti-link, tag everyone, and admin commands to keep groups tidy.

features.title: Stickers and media
features.text: Turn images and videos into stickers, and download music and video by sending a link.

features.title: Online around the clock
features.text: The bot runs on cloud servers, so it keeps replying even when your phone is off.

features.title: You stay in control
features.text: It connects as a linked device. Remove it from WhatsApp settings any time to disconnect.

steps.title: Open the pairing page
steps.text: Tap “Connect Bot” or “Go to Pairing Section” from the menu.

steps.title: Enter your number
steps.text: Type it with a plus sign and country code, like +919876543210. No spaces needed.

steps.title: Copy the code
steps.text: Tap Copy Code. In WhatsApp, go to Linked Devices, then Link with phone number instead.

steps.title: Paste and start using
steps.text: Enter the code in WhatsApp. The bot connects and you can send your first command.

faq.a: Pairing itself is just a number and a code. If you have questions about plans or limits, message us through Bot Support.

faq.q: My code does not work. What should I do?
faq.a: Codes expire in a couple of minutes. Check that your number starts with + and the country code, then generate a new code and enter it right away.
Any country. Always type the number as + then the country code then your number, for example +14155552671 or +919876543210.

faq.q: How do I disconnect the bot?
faq.a: Open WhatsApp, go to Linked Devices, tap the bot session and choose Log out.

faq.q: Should I use the code or the QR?
faq.a: Use the code if you are on one phone, since you cannot scan your own screen. Use the QR when you have a second device.
